  { symbol: '^FTSE', name: 'FTSE 100' },
  { symbol: '^N225', name: 'Nikkei 225' },
  { symbol: '^HSI', name: 'Hang Seng' },
  { symbol: '^STI', name: 'Straits Times Index (STI)' },
